outcome: Cord blood native thiol/total thiol ratio
cohort: The study included 40 pregnant women with meconium-stained amniotic fluid and 40 pregnant women with non-meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
finding: Pregnant women with meconium-stained amniotic fluid exhibited decreased maternal native thiol and total thiol levels and increased maternal ischemia modified albumin (IMA) levels, suggesting a shift of antioxidant balance toward oxidant in this group.
cross-section timing: During maternal labor and in newborn umbilical cord blood at the first minute after birth
